text:
sasha: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we saw a recurring pattern where DNS TTL churn + LB route rebalances caused spikes of 504s for cross-region traffic (eu -> na) during the 2026-03-17 maintenance window. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2189990000 — opening thread to track owners + timelines.

cory: yep. two root contributors: (A) registrar rate-limiting causing delayed name updates, (B) the LB's sticky session mapping falling back to legacy backends when edge route table didn't update in time.

lee: curious if TLS resume played any role here or if it was purely routing/DNS? I saw a handful of handshake timeouts during the same window.

sasha: small fraction were TLS handshake timeouts but traced those to retries when route proxy dropped the connection mid-handshake. so it's a routing/timing problem that cascaded into TLS retries.

engbot: Incident 2189990000 summarized: dns-ttl-flap + lb-route-fallback. Severity P2. Linked tickets: INC-9312, TKT-2244.

tanvi: propose concrete remediation list (draft):
- lower registrar request burst rate (owner: cory)
- add pre-warm route propagation check in deploy pipeline (owner: lee)
- add metric & alert on route-mismatch ratio (owner: tanvi)
- update LB sticky-session fallback to respect route-version tag (owner: olga)
- runbook: add troubleshooting steps and customer messaging template (owner: sasha)

olga: can we add acceptance criteria? otherwise this drifts.

cory: timelines I can hit:
- registrar rate-limit change: 2026-04-03 (change + verify)
- will open vendor ticket this afternoon and post response ETA.

lee: pre-warm check: I'll add a gating webhook in the deploy pipeline that queries route propagation. Target: 2026-04-01 for PR + canary.

tanvi: metrics + alert: I'll add Prometheus rule + console alert. Proposed alert: route_mismatch_ratio > 0.2% for 10m -> P3. Target: 2026-03-31.

olga: LB fallback guard: we need to ensure sticky sessions don't map to backends without the route-version tag. I'll prototype a guard by 2026-04-07; canary 10% then expand.

sasha: runbook and CS blurb: I'll draft by EOD and share. We should include a list of impacted customers and suggested customer messaging.

lee: quick PromQL for the route-mismatch metric I'm planning to add:

```
sum(rate(edge_route_mismatch_total[5m])) / sum(rate(edge_requests_total[5m]))
```

engbot: Reminder: please include ticket numbers when you claim ownership so we can link to the postmortem.

cory: created vendor ticket VND-4478, vendor response ETA 2026-03-25. I'll update INC-9312.

tanvi: adding a synthetic check: every 5m from eu-west simulate a full request path and validate route-version header. Script in ops repo: `scripts/synthetics/route-version-checker.sh`

sasha: acceptance criteria (per item):
- registrar burst limit: vendor confirms ability to smooth updates and we observe registrar_error_rate < 0.01% for 24h post-change
- pre-warm gate: deploy pipeline rejects rollout if route_version != expected on >1% of edges during canary window
- metric alert: alert fires when route_mismatch_ratio > 0.2% for 10m and escalates to P2 if >1% for 15m
- LB guard: no sticky-fallback events in canary (10% traffic) for 2h, then expand if stable
- runbook: runbook PR merged and ops-runbook tag created

olga: note on rollback strategy: if LB guard causes higher 5xx, rollback key change by reverting lb-config map and reassigning sticky cookies. I'll document the k8s rollback commands and practice in staging.

lee: planning a short smoke test checklist (will paste in PR):
- run route-version-checker from eu-west 10x -> expect route-version header X-RW-Route-Version == v42
- check `sum(rate(edge_route_mismatch_total[5m]))` < 5 over 15m
- run TLS handshake smoke `openssl s_client -connect edge-proxy:443 -servername api.redwood.example -sess_out sess.bin` and verify session resume behavior

tanvi: I'll wire the synthetic into the console and create a dashboard tile for the next 7 days to watch any recurrence patterns.

cory: vendor replied: they're throttling registrar updates during high-change windows. They offered a staged API but need us to alter our update cadence. I'll coordinate the change and test on the registrar sandbox.

sasha: customer comms: CS notified top 8 accounts with summary + mitigation steps. Nikhil from CS suggested offering a status update once the canary passes.

engbot: Scheduled: sync meeting set for 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC to review PRs + canary readiness (calendar invite sent).

olga: acked. I'll open LB guard PR today and reference TKT-2244.

lee: ack, will open deploy gate PR and add tests.

tanvi: ack, I'll create the alert PR and dashboard tile.

cory: ack, vendor coord in progress.

sasha: thanks everyone. I'll keep this thread updated with links to PRs + runbook. Reopen if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
